articles.title: Welcoming Jon Xu and Andrew Miklas as YC’s Newest General Partners
articles.summary: Over the last few batches, visiting partners Jon Xu and Andrew Miklas have become two of the most trusted voices in the YC community. They were both founders in YC’s Summer 2010 batch, and now, 15 years and two industry-shaping companies later, they’re back in a new role: General Partners at YC.
